sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233902 (search/campsites API, read 2026-10-28)

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog 233902 (4 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, 007 and 024-026, all reservable public sites: Electricity Hookup 30, Water Hookup Y, Sewer Hookup Y; the other 24 sites list none) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/matterhorn-campground-norwood-rd ('28 campsites with 4 of them offering RV hookups (electricity and septic)'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 28 sites: 25 for RVs (4 full-hookup) and 3 walk-to tent sites (012-014). Forest Service: maximum spur 45 ft; recreation.gov rates the sites 30-40 ft (the hookup sites 30). Four pull-throughs. One camping unit per standard site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/matterhorn-campground-norwood-rd ('There are 28 campsites'; 'Maximum spur length - 45 feet') + recreation.gov catalog 233902 (25 STANDARD + 3 TENT ONLY; Max Vehicle Length 30/35/40; Pull-Through 004, 006, 008, 018) + recreation.gov notice 'Standard Single Family sites: Recreation Use Fee allows ONE camping unit ONLY', read 2026-10-28

values.note: Showers are open to day users too ($8 for non-registered guests). Firewood $10 a bundle.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233902 ('Flush and vault toilets, drinking water, showers and trash collection are provided') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/matterhorn-campground-norwood-rd ('This site now has potable water'; 'Showers are available to both overnight and day use guests'; '$8 for showers (for non-registered guests)'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Forest Service: 'Late Spring to Early Fall - weather dependent'. Dates are recreation.gov's 2026 fee seasons (first-come May 17 - June 4, reserved June 5 - Sept 12, first-come Sept 13-30); 2027 so far lists May 28 - Sept 30.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233902/rates (2026 First-come 05-17 to 06-04, Peak 06-05 to 09-12, First-come 09-13 to 09-30; 2027 Peak 05-28 to 09-12, First-come 09-13 to 09-30) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/matterhorn-campground-norwood-rd ('Seasons of Use: Late Spring to Early Fall - weather dependent'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 14 sites reservable (incl. all 4 hookup sites), the rest first-come; outside the peak season every site is walk-in. Book at least 4 days ahead; weekend 2-night minimum; up to 7 consecutive nights per reservation. First-come sites are claimed in person only ('DO NOT call to determine availability'). A reserved site is held 24 hours after check-in time. 2027 reservation season May 28 - Sept 12 (2026: June 5 - Sept 12).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233902 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 7, minWeekendStay 2, reservationCutOff 4; notices on first-come sites and late arrivals) + /rates (Peak Season 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-12; 2026-06-05 to 2026-09-12) + catalog 233902 (14 reservable sites), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $26 non-electric, $40 full hookup (2026-2028). Extra vehicles $13-23 a night, paid to the host on arrival.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233902/rates (STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, STANDARD ELECTRIC 40, 2026-2028) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/matterhorn-campground-norwood-rd ('Single Site Non-Electric: $26 per night'; 'Single Site Electric: $40 per night'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $13-23 per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: Uncompahgre NF beside CO-145 (San Juan Skyway, paved) ~7 mi south of Telluride, at ~9,500 ft. Outer-loop sites are wooded, inner-loop sites open; the walk-to tent sites have panoramic mountain views. The Galloping Goose Trail leaves from the campground; Lizard Head Wilderness is ~3 mi. --Claude
